propositions: gerrit-verify.yaml's build-and-test job hand-copies gate and test command sequences from test.yml, creating a drift risk policed by test_ci_workflow_parity.py

a single reusable workflow (_build-and-test.yml) parameterized by gerrit-refspec should define lint, pip-audit, and test jobs so both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml delegate to one source, making drift impossible by construction

test_ci_workflow_parity.py's five functions must be rewritten to assert delegation to the shared reusable and validate single-source content rather than copy-sync equivalence, while preserving three independent safety invariants (gate existence, script gating, pre-commit skip behavior)

the reusable workflow must take no secrets and use conditional checkout logic (actions/checkout for branch-head when gerrit-refspec is empty, checkout-gerrit-change-action for patchsets when set) mirroring _optionality.yml's pattern

test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must both reference the reusable via delegation, with gerrit-verify's build-and-test job split to run lint once instead of in the os×py matrix, while preserving job-graph parallelism and vote-needs dependencies
